item.tib: snying po bsdu pa zhes bya ba
item.skt: saM gra ha gar+b+ha nA ma
item.coloph: snying po bsdu pa zhes bya ba/ slob dpon chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /paN+Di ta de nyid dang/ lo tsA ba dge slong tshul khrims 'byung gnas zhi bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o
